findings.evidence: "The summary shows the equipment cost and the requested delivery date."
findings.fix: Add a step explaining when employees enter or request a delivery date during the application process.
findings.location: How to Apply section, third paragraph
findings.violation: The document does not explain when or how employees specify a delivery date before this summary is shown.

findings.evidence: "However, an incomplete request pauses the timeline until the missing item arrives."
findings.fix: Replace "missing item" with "missing documentation" or another specific term that makes clear what must arrive to resume the timeline.
findings.violation: "Missing item" is ambiguous - it is unclear whether this refers to missing documentation or something else.

findings.evidence: "A photo of the receipt is enough for most requests. Additionally, employees shall retain receipts for one year after the purchase date."
findings.fix: Specify whether digital photos of receipts are acceptable for the one-year retention requirement, or whether original receipts must be kept.
findings.violation: The first sentence permits photos, but the second requires retaining receipts - it is unclear whether a digital photo satisfies the one-year retention requirement.

findings.evidence: "Similarly, the policy applies to one device per category per employee whenever the benefits team confirms that the role genuinely requires a second device because fieldwork regularly takes the employee away from the single fixed desk that the standard equipment list assumes every applicant has for the whole benefit year while the finance office tracks the second device against the same annual amount that the equipment catalog publishes for each category."
findings.fix: Break into separate sentences that clearly state when a second device is permitted, what conditions must be met, and how it is tracked.
findings.location: Restrictions and Exceptions section, second paragraph
findings.violation: This sentence is a run-on with tangled clauses that obscures the policy for second devices.

findings.evidence: "Completing the request begins with confirming eligibility, and uploading the receipt."
findings.fix: Either list all steps or revise "begins with" to "requires" or "involves."
findings.violation: The phrase "begins with" implies additional steps follow, but none are listed, leaving the instructions incomplete.

findings.evidence: "The benefits team tracks the stipend budget at the start of the fiscal year. Staff can request a printed copy from the benefits team at any time." (Program Overview and Special Cases); "Every entry carries a date stamp so the record stays easy to audit." (Program Overview and Questions and Updates)
findings.fix: Retain this information in Program Overview only and remove it from Special Cases and Questions and Updates.
findings.location: Program Overview, Special Cases, and Questions and Updates sections
findings.violation: Identical or near-identical sentences about budget tracking appear in three separate sections, creating unnecessary duplication and confusion about which office is responsible.
